description: This file defines a template class StreamJSONType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, implementing a JSON stream handler with serialization and deserialization capabilities, including internal classes for managing JSON data transmission over a network or inter-process communication.

classes.name: StreamJSONType
classes.description: A template class providing JSON stream serialization/deserialization with internal handler, serializer, and deserializer classes.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements into a stream, managing a queue and lock.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of JSON elements from a stream, managing current element and state.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A handler class inheriting from SOURCE, managing data transmission and state changes.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal channel handler.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received JSON elements.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send JSON elements.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a JSON element for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the serializer and deserializer are idle.
